title: Maps
explain: A map holds key-value pairs and is created with `make` or a literal. Reading a missing key gives the zero value, so use the two-value form `v, ok := m[k]` to tell the difference. Ranging over a map visits keys in random order, but `fmt` prints maps sorted by key.
exercise: Count how many times each word appears in a sentence using a map.
tip: Writing to a nil map panics. Create it with `make(map[K]V)` or a literal before you assign to it.
